signatures.description: Confirmed artifact (S01E01-S06 audit, 2026-09-11): faster-whisper large-v3 repeatedly inserted 'Altyazı M.K.' ("Subtitle by M.K.") mid-sentence into unrelated dialogue across every checked episode. Classic subtitle-credit training-data contamination, the same family as Whisper's documented 'thanks for watching' hallucination. Evidence for this entry: 26 occurrences / 5 episodes, always mid-sentence, never explained by nearby audio content.

Turkish broadcaster (TRT) audio-description disclaimer. Lower weight than the credit pattern: this text is plausibly genuinely spoken by an announcer in some broadcasts, not purely hallucinated -- treat as suspect, not certain, pending audio confirmation.
